shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin briefly surpassed $84,000 after strong SpaceX earnings but later reversed gains alongside tech stock jitters.
US jobless claims dropped to near a 57-year low, raising uncertainty regarding upcoming Federal Reserve rate cuts.
South Korea is finalizing a comprehensive crypto and stablecoin bill, while the US OCC issued final stablecoin regulations.
Deutsche Bank is launching an Ethereum-based custody service, and JPMorgan migrated JPM Coin to the Ethereum mainnet.
